state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]` (`crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs`'s module doc). `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs` has an owned `Cursor`, and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` (an owned `Entries`) and `read`. `nvs-stdlib-ldap-connect-open-and-search`'s five tests pass against `samba-ad`. `Core\Ldap\LdapError` carries `kind` and `code` (`?int`, `null` where no server sent one).

**A Novis program can now call `Core\Ldap::connect` and `Core\Ldap::open`.** `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs` registers `Core\Ldap` (both members, with cards), `Ldap\Connection` (one `handle` slot and no members yet), `Ldap\Tls` and the `Ldap\Settings` shape (`url`, `user`, `password`, `tls`, `timeout`; slots `URL_ARG`..`TIMEOUT_ARG`). The helpers `nvs_core_ldap_connect`/`nvs_core_ldap_open` and `ldap::address` sit at the end of `mod.rs`. Six server-free cases under `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-*` and `ldap-open-*` hold the floor of three per member; `ldap-connect-without-a-grant-throws.nvst` is one of the acceptance check's two cases.

`Ldap\Settings` still lacks ADR 0278 § 2's `base` (it needs `Dn`, Stage 5) and `tlsCaFile` (a program-supplied path sink, not decided). `rule:security/ldap-pool-is-bound-as-its-block` stays `designed` until a Novis case guards it.

**A conformance case cannot reach Samba yet.** No `.nvst` in the tree talks to a container, so `ldap-connect-and-search.nvst` needs a way to name `samba-ad`'s URL and CA (an `--ENV--` section feeding `nvs.toml`, or a `--SKIPIF--` on the port). Find how `crates/nvs-test` expands `--ENV--` before writing it.

items.text: **`Ldap\Connection`'s members and `Ldap\Entries`/`Ldap\Entry`**: `whoami`, `search`, `read` on `CONNECTION` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:200`, an `Entries` class that is its own iterator (the `Core\Db\Stream` pattern at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/stream.rs:81`: a `DISPATCH_ROSTER` row in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/instance.rs:200`, an `ITERABLES` row in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, and the `HOST_HANDLE_CLASSES` row), `Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`, `toArray`), and `Ldap\Scope`. `Entries` needs somewhere to keep `nvs_stdlib::ldap::Entries` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:408`): park the cursor on `Held` keyed per search, the way `Core\Db\Stream` parks its cursor on the connection, since an object slot holds only a `Value`. `search` takes a `Filter`, so the smallest `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`) comes with it. ADR 0278 § 1 and § 5. Each member needs three cases, and every case past `whoami` needs `samba-ad`.
**`tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst`** against `samba-ad`, once a case can name its URL and CA (see State). `--ENV--` is parsed at `crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs:607`.

backlog: `Ldap\Connection` is on the `HANDLES` list in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`'s `a_class_with_slots_has_instance_members_and_the_reverse`. Take it off when its first member lands, or that test fails.
